# Arda Akgül

> Official website of Arda Akgül, Economics and Business Administration student at TED University in Ankara, Undergraduate Research Assistant at TEDUsTRC, and writer on trade, sustainability, energy policy, and technology in public life.

Arda Akgül is Vice President of the TEDU Economics Research Union, a Researcher at DASAM, founder of Monarch Castle Technologies, and co-founder of SDCofA. His economics thesis examines EU exposure, CBAM, and sustainability reporting in the aluminum sector.

## Canonical Pages

- [About](https://arda-akgul.com/about/index.md): biography, education, affiliations, and profile context.
- [Publications](https://arda-akgul.com/publications/): publication record with outlet references and dates.
- [Experience](https://arda-akgul.com/experience/): research assistance, institutional roles, and media work.
- [Contact](https://arda-akgul.com/contact/index.md): academic and editorial contact route.
- [FAQ](https://arda-akgul.com/faq/index.md): concise answers on identity, study, and contact.

## Writing

- [Publication Essays](https://arda-akgul.com/publications/): first-person analytical site essays on surveillance, payments, adblocking, data integration, and Turkish public data.
  - [We Have to Give Up Our Privacy](https://arda-akgul.com/publications/we-have-to-give-up-our-privacy/): privacy as a wasting asset; HNDL, qualified rights, accountability over secrecy.
  - [Why I Stopped Fighting the Cameras](https://arda-akgul.com/publications/why-i-stopped-fighting-the-cameras/): urban sensors as infrastructure, judged by outcomes.
  - [How I Pay for Everything](https://arda-akgul.com/publications/how-i-pay-for-everything/): cashless student budgeting and spending visibility.
  - [Why I Turned Adblock Off](https://arda-akgul.com/publications/why-i-turned-adblock-off/): ad blockers, half-pages, and the relevance feedback loop.
  - [What Palantir Actually Builds](https://arda-akgul.com/publications/what-palantir-actually-builds/): ontology layers and data integration as infrastructure.
  - [Data Partnerships in Turkish Public Services](https://arda-akgul.com/publications/data-partnerships-turkish-public-services/): join keys, EU Data Act patterns, and stakeholder value.
- [Writing](https://arda-akgul.com/blogs/): essays, notes, and topic-led archive.
- [Economics](https://arda-akgul.com/blogs/economics/): trade, incentives, institutions, and policy.
- [Sustainability](https://arda-akgul.com/blogs/sustainability/): energy transition and long-term economic questions.
- [Technology and Public Life](https://arda-akgul.com/blogs/tech-computing/): digital systems, AI, and public consequences.
- [Business and Industry](https://arda-akgul.com/blogs/business-industry/): firms, strategy, and industrial analysis.
- [Culture and Ideas](https://arda-akgul.com/blogs/culture/): literature and intellectual history.
- [Mathematics](https://arda-akgul.com/blogs/mathematics/): geometry and the mathematics of AI.
- [Guides](https://arda-akgul.com/guides/): practical notes on sustainability and preparedness.
